<p class="sarna-lede">A curated literature resource for small activating RNA (saRNA) sequences, experimental conditions, and reported outcomes.</p>

<p class="sarna-institutional-note">Developed at {{< var institution-name >}} · {{< var department-name >}}</p>

::: {.sarna-status}
**{{< var database-status >}}**

The first validated database release will accompany the associated review article. No preliminary or unvalidated data are currently public.
:::

## Purpose

The resource will bring together structured information from the saRNA literature, making published sequence and experimental information easier to find, compare, cite, and reuse.

## Planned functionality

<div class="sarna-card-grid">
